reuse.why: Extends the shared shouldBudgetCategory predicate, but detects the tag with a raw SQL LIKE '%#fixed%' instead of the existing extractTagsFromText tag parser in #shared/tags.

duplication.why: The tag test (n.note LIKE '%#fixed%') and the notes join are pasted into six separate SQL queries, so the real decision is copied six times.

placement.why: The predicate in month-budget-categories.ts only reads a precomputed flag; the substance of the rule (what counts as a #fixed tag) lives in SQL strings scattered across the action functions.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, the shared predicate and a test are touched.

maintainability.why: Changing what counts as the fixed tag requires editing six SQL strings consistently, and the substring match diverges from the app's tag semantics.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Tag detection via SQL LIKE in getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg bypasses extractTagsFromText in packages/loot-core/src/shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated LIKE expression and join are verbatim copies across the six queries, not disguised.

one_place.where: shouldBudgetCategory only checks group_fixed; the rule itself (n.note LIKE '%#fixed%') is defined separately in each of six queries in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts.
